# YOLOv3 (PPU, 608x608)

Object Detection · `yolov3_608x608_ppu` · DX-APP Python example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 608 × 608 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** Public Domain · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![YOLOv3 (PPU, 608x608) output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models YOLOV3_3_PPU
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolo_ppu/yolov3_608x608_ppu/yolov3_608x608_ppu_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov3_608x608_ppu.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov3_608x608_ppu_sync   # once
./bin/yolov3_608x608_ppu_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov3_608x608_ppu.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 42.60 |
| Q-Lite | 42.28 (−0.32) |
| Q-Pro | 42.10 (−0.50) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
